Job Description Summary

Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in applied microeconomics, with
particular interest in candidates working in health economics; to
teach courses at the undergraduate and Master’s level; to publish
original high-quality research; to advise students; and to engage
in service. Multiple positions available.

Job Description

The Department of Economics at Miami University invites
applications for two tenure-track assistant professor positions.
Duties include teaching courses at the undergraduate and Master’s
level, publishing original high-quality research, advising
students, and engaging in service.

The Department of Economics, which is in the Farmer School of
Business, has approximately 500 undergraduate majors and 15
students in its Master’s of Economics program. High quality
teaching and research are both valued in the department, which is
composed of approximately 25 tenured/tenure-track, teaching, and
visiting faculty.

For consideration, the applicant must have a complete application,
which includes the submission of all the required materials in two
steps. The applicant must apply through the AEA’s job application
system ( 
https://www.aeaweb.org/joe/listing.php?JOE_ID=2026-02_111477934
) as well as the Miami's application system ( 
https://miamioh.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/miamioh-faculty/job/Assistant-Professor---Economics_JR104790-1
).

Minimum Qualifications:

Required: Ph.D. in economics or related discipline by date of
appointment.

Consideration will be given to candidates with research interests
in applied microeconomics and especially health economics.

Additional Position Information (if applicable)

Required Application Documents

Submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, teaching statement,
evidence of teaching performance (if available), and research
sample to the AEA's job application system and to Miami. The
teaching statement should address how the candidate fosters
classroom engagement with respect to student background and
learning style.

Miami University Values Statement
Miami
University is a scholarly community whose members believe that
a liberal education is grounded in qualities of character as well
as of intellect. We respect the dignity of other persons, the
rights and property of others, and the right of others to hold and
express disparate beliefs. We believe in honesty, integrity, and
the importance of moral conduct. We defend the freedom of inquiry
that is the heart of learning and combine that freedom with the
exercise of judgment and the acceptance of personal
responsibility.

For more information on Miami University’s mission and core values,
please visit the Mission and Core Values webpage.
